about: Coral Drift's coral arch (open-plots build-out OB5, art/coral-drift/round-2-landmark): Hunyuan3D 2.1 (seed 42) on a BiRefNet cutout of the codex image_gen reference ref-arch.jpg (from the look loop's plaza and under-the-arch targets), picked over TRELLIS.2 and the retired Blender script (coral.py, in git history). Flat shaded (--smooth-angle 0) to keep the plot's faceted look. Near 15k triangles on a 512 WebP atlas, far 2.5k smooth at 256, no normal map; layouts/coral-drift.json stands it 25 m tall, turn 0.
